description: In mail/src/server.rs lines 329 and 331, build_mta_sts_policy_body uses body.push_str(&format!(...)) which allocates an intermediate String. The idiomatic Rust pattern is use std::fmt::Write; write!(body, ...).unwrap() which writes directly into the String without an intermediate allocation. Two occurrences: mx pattern loop (line 329) and max_age line (line 331). P2 unnecessary allocation.
title: Idiom review iter-4: push_str(&format!()) in build_mta_sts_policy_body
